9	/-!
10	# The Čech–Picard dictionary for affine schemes: the descent homomorphism
11	
12	For an affine scheme `X`, this file assembles the Picard classes of unit Čech cocycles
13	along basic refinements (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicAffineCover`) into an injective
14	group homomorphism
15	
16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.toPic : X.CechPic →* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`
17	
18	from the definitional Čech Picard group into mathlib's Picard group of the global
19	sections.  (Surjectivity — hence the full dictionary `X.CechPic ≃* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`
20	— is the invertible-module-trivialization direction, treated separately.)
21	
22	The core is the **independence of the descent Picard class from every choice**
23	(`BasicRefinement.pic_congr`): representing cocycle of the `H¹` class, basic refinement,
24	and pointed cover.  All comparisons are routed through three elementary moves:
25	
26	* `pic_res` — replacing the pointed cover by a finer one and restricting the cocycle
27	  does not change the refinement data nor the class (the restricted evaluations agree on
28	  the nose);
29	* `pic_eq_of_isCohomologous` — cohomologous cocycles give equal classes (the comparison
30	  restricts to an index-wise coboundary; coboundary invariance of the descended module);
31	* `pic_interFst` / `pic_inter` / `pic_interFst_eq_inter` — any two basic refinements of
32	  the same cover are dominated by their merge, on which the two point-selections differ
33	  by the index-wise coboundary of the cross evaluations `γ (pt i, pt' j)`; hence all
34	  refinements give the same class.
35	
36	Injectivity is refinement injectivity: a trivial descent class makes the descent unit a
37	coboundary (`Module.IsDescentCocycle.picClass_eq_one_iff`), whose components glue back to
38	a coboundary on the pointed cover itself
39	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsH1_eq_one_of_family`).
40	-/
41	
42	set_option autoImplicit false
43	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
44	
45	universe u
46	
47	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
48	
49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
50	
51	namespace Scheme
52	
53	namespace PointedCover.BasicRefinement
54	
55	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
56	
57	/-! ## Lifting refinements along cover refinement -/
58	
59	/-- A basic refinement of a finer pointed cover is one of the coarser cover. -/
60	@[simps ι pt r]
61	def ofLE {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (P : 𝒱.BasicRefinement) :
62	    𝒰.BasicRefinement where
63	  ι := P.ι
64	  pt := P.pt
65	  r := P.r
66	  basicOpen_le i := (P.basicOpen_le i).trans (h (P.pt i))
67	  iSup_eq := P.iSup_eq
68	
69	/-- The merge of two basic refinements of the same cover, pointed by the **first**
70	factor.  Defined by updating the points of `inter`, so that the index family and the
71	sections are *definitionally those of `P.inter Q`*. -/
72	@[simps pt]
73	def interFst {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (P Q : 𝒰.BasicRefinement) : 𝒰.BasicRefinement :=
74	  { P.inter Q with
75	    pt := fun p ↦ P.pt p.1
76	    basicOpen_le := fun p ↦
77	      ((X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_left).trans (P.basicOpen_le p.1) }
78	
79	@[simp]
80	lemma interFst_r {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (P Q : 𝒰.BasicRefinement) (p : P.ι × Q.ι) :
81	    (P.interFst Q).r p = P.r p.1 * Q.r p.2 :=
82	  rfl
83	
84	section pic
85	
86	variable [IsAffine X] {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover}
87	
88	/-! ## Move 1: restriction along a refinement of pointed covers -/
89	
90	/-- Restricting the cocycle to a finer pointed cover and lifting the basic refinement
91	back does not change the Picard class: the two cover cocycles agree on the nose. -/
92	theorem pic_ofLE (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (P : 𝒱.BasicRefinement) (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
93	    (P.ofLE h).pic γ = P.pic (γ.res fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)) := by
94	  -- Both sides are `picClass` of `isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit` for the same data:
95	  -- `coverCocycle` of the restricted cocycle is the composed restriction of the same
96	  -- evaluations.
97	  have hcc : (P.ofLE h).coverCocycle γ = P.coverCocycle (γ.res fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)) := by
98	    funext i j
99	    rw [coverCocycle, coverCocycle, res_unitsEvInf h γ, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict]
100	    rfl
101	  haveI := (P.ofLE h).faithfullyFlat
102	  haveI := P.faithfullyFlat
103	  exact Module.IsDescentCocycle.picClass_congr _ _ (congrArg _ hcc)
104	
105	/-! ## Move 2: cohomologous cocycles -/
106	
107	
108	/-- Cohomologous unit cocycles have the same Picard class along any basic refinement. -/
109	theorem pic_eq_of_isCohomologous (P : 𝒰.BasicRefinement) {γ γ' : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰}
110	    (h : γ.IsCohomologous γ') : P.pic γ = P.pic γ' := by
111	  letI := P.faithfullyFlat
112	  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp h
113	  -- restate the comparison through the `Γ`-typed interface
114	  have hα' : ∀ z w : X,
115	      X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒰.opens z ⊓ 𝒰.opens w ≤ 𝒰.opens z) (α z)
116	          * unitsEvInf γ z w
117	        = unitsEvInf γ' z w
118	          * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒰.opens z ⊓ 𝒰.opens w ≤ 𝒰.opens w) (α w) :=
119	    fun z w ↦ hα z w
120	  have hrel : ∀ i j, (P.coverCocycle γ i j).val
121	      = IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclLeft (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
122	          (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
123	          (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i j
124	          ((X.unitsRestrict (P.basicOpen_le i) (α (P.pt i)))⁻¹ : _).val
125	        * ((P.coverCocycle γ' i j).val
126	          * IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclRight (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
127	              (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
128	              (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i j
129	              ((((X.unitsRestrict (P.basicOpen_le j) (α (P.pt j)))⁻¹)⁻¹ : _).val)) := by
130	    intro i j
131	    rw [P.inclLeft_eq_basicRes, P.inclRight_eq_basicRes, inv_inv]
132	    -- units-level form of the component relation
133	    have e := congrArg (X.unitsRestrict (P.overlap_le i j)) (hα' (P.pt i) (P.pt j))
134	    rw [map_mul, map_mul] at e
135	    have key : P.coverCocycle γ i j
136	        = X.unitsRestrict (P.mul_le_left i j)
137	            ((X.unitsRestrict (P.basicOpen_le i) (α (P.pt i)))⁻¹)
138	          * (P.coverCocycle γ' i j
139	            * X.unitsRestrict (P.mul_le_right i j)
140	                ((X.unitsRestrict (P.basicOpen_le j) (α (P.pt j))))) := by
141	      rw [map_inv, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict]
142	      rw [coverCocycle, coverCocycle]
143	      rw [show X.unitsRestrict ((P.mul_le_left i j).trans (P.basicOpen_le i)) (α (P.pt i))
144	          = X.unitsRestrict (P.overlap_le i j)
145	              (X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒰.opens (P.pt i) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (P.pt j)
146	                ≤ 𝒰.opens (P.pt i)) (α (P.pt i)))
147	        from (unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict _ _ _).symm,
148	        show X.unitsRestrict ((P.mul_le_right i j).trans (P.basicOpen_le j)) (α (P.pt j))
149	          = X.unitsRestrict (P.overlap_le i j)
150	              (X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒰.opens (P.pt i) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (P.pt j)
151	                ≤ 𝒰.opens (P.pt j)) (α (P.pt j)))
152	        from (unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict _ _ _).symm]
153	      rw [← e]
154	      group
155	    have hval := congrArg Units.val key
156	    simpa only [Units.val_mul, coe_unitsRestrict_basicOpen] using hval
157	  rw [P.pic_eq_picClass γ, P.pic_eq_picClass γ']
158	  exact IsLocalization.AwayCover.picClass_eq_of_coboundary (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
159	    (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
160	    (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j)))
161	    (W := fun i j k ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * (P.r j * P.r k))))
162	    (P.isCoverCocycle γ') (P.isCoverCocycle γ)
163	    (fun i ↦ (X.unitsRestrict (P.basicOpen_le i) (α (P.pt i)))⁻¹) hrel
164	
165	/-! ## Move 3: change of basic refinement -/
166	
167	/-- Refine-compare along the first projection: the merge pointed by `P` has the same
168	Picard class as `P`. -/
169	theorem pic_interFst (P Q : 𝒰.BasicRefinement)
170	    (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) : (P.interFst Q).pic γ = P.pic γ := by
171	  letI := P.faithfullyFlat
172	  letI := (P.interFst Q).faithfullyFlat
173	  have hτ : ∀ p : P.ι × Q.ι,
174	      IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p)) (P.r p.1)) :=
175	    fun p ↦ IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd ((P.interFst Q).r p)
176	      (⟨Q.r p.2, rfl⟩ : P.r p.1 ∣ (P.interFst Q).r p)
177	  have hτT : ∀ p q : P.ι × Q.ι,
178	      IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, ⊤)
179	        Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q))
180	        (P.r p.1 * P.r q.1)) :=
181	    fun p q ↦ IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd ((P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q)
182	      (⟨Q.r p.2 * Q.r q.2, by simp only [interFst_r]; ring⟩ :
183	        P.r p.1 * P.r q.1 ∣ (P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q)
184	  have hrel : ∀ p q : P.ι × Q.ι, (P.interFst Q).coverCocycle γ p q
185	      = Units.map (IsLocalization.AwayCover.refineOverlapAlgHom (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
186	          (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j)))
187	          (T' := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q)))
188	          Prod.fst hτT p q).toRingHom.toMonoidHom (P.coverCocycle γ p.1 q.1) := by
189	    intro p q
190	    have hle : X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q)
191	        ≤ X.basicOpen (P.r p.1 * P.r q.1) :=
192	      X.basicOpen_le_of_dvd ⟨Q.r p.2 * Q.r q.2, by simp only [interFst_r]; ring⟩
193	    have hro : IsLocalization.AwayCover.refineOverlapAlgHom (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
194	          (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j)))
195	          (T' := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q)))
196	          Prod.fst hτT p q
197	        = X.basicRes _ _ hle :=
198	      X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _
199	    rw [hro]
200	    have hmap : Units.map ((X.basicRes _ _ hle)).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
201	          (P.coverCocycle γ p.1 q.1)
202	        = X.unitsRestrict hle (P.coverCocycle γ p.1 q.1) := rfl
203	    rw [hmap, coverCocycle, coverCocycle, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict]
204	    rfl
205	  rw [pic_eq_picClass, pic_eq_picClass]
206	  exact IsLocalization.AwayCover.picClass_map_refine (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
207	    (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
208	    (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j)))
209	    (W := fun i j k ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * (P.r j * P.r k))))
210	    (f' := (P.interFst Q).r)
211	    (S' := fun p ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p)))
212	    (T' := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p * (P.interFst Q).r q)))
213	    Prod.fst hτ hτT
214	    (W' := fun p q t ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.interFst Q).r p
215	      * ((P.interFst Q).r q * (P.interFst Q).r t))))
216	    (P.isCoverCocycle γ) ((P.interFst Q).isCoverCocycle γ) hrel
217	
218	/-- Refine-compare along the second projection: the merge pointed by `Q` has the same
219	Picard class as `Q`. -/
220	theorem pic_inter (P : 𝒰.BasicRefinement) (Q : 𝒱.BasicRefinement)
221	    (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒱) : (P.inter Q).pic γ = Q.pic γ := by
222	  letI := Q.faithfullyFlat
223	  letI := (P.inter Q).faithfullyFlat
224	  have hτ : ∀ p : P.ι × Q.ι,
225	      IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p)) (Q.r p.2)) :=
226	    fun p ↦ IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd ((P.inter Q).r p)
227	      (⟨P.r p.1, mul_comm _ _⟩ : Q.r p.2 ∣ (P.inter Q).r p)
228	  have hτT : ∀ p q : P.ι × Q.ι,
229	      IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, ⊤)
230	        Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q))
231	        (Q.r p.2 * Q.r q.2)) :=
232	    fun p q ↦ IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)
233	      (⟨P.r p.1 * P.r q.1, by simp only [inter_r]; ring⟩ :
234	        Q.r p.2 * Q.r q.2 ∣ (P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)
235	  have hrel : ∀ p q : P.ι × Q.ι, (P.inter Q).coverCocycle γ p q
236	      = Units.map (IsLocalization.AwayCover.refineOverlapAlgHom (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := Q.r)
237	          (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (Q.r i * Q.r j)))
238	          (T' := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)))
239	          Prod.snd hτT p q).toRingHom.toMonoidHom (Q.coverCocycle γ p.2 q.2) := by
240	    intro p q
241	    have hle : X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)
242	        ≤ X.basicOpen (Q.r p.2 * Q.r q.2) :=
243	      X.basicOpen_le_of_dvd ⟨P.r p.1 * P.r q.1, by simp only [inter_r]; ring⟩
244	    have hro : IsLocalization.AwayCover.refineOverlapAlgHom (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := Q.r)
245	          (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (Q.r i * Q.r j)))
246	          (T' := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)))
247	          Prod.snd hτT p q
248	        = X.basicRes _ _ hle :=
249	      X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _
250	    rw [hro]
251	    have hmap : Units.map ((X.basicRes _ _ hle)).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
252	          (Q.coverCocycle γ p.2 q.2)
253	        = X.unitsRestrict hle (Q.coverCocycle γ p.2 q.2) := rfl
254	    rw [hmap, coverCocycle, coverCocycle, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict]
255	    rfl
256	  rw [pic_eq_picClass, pic_eq_picClass]
257	  exact IsLocalization.AwayCover.picClass_map_refine (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := Q.r)
258	    (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (Q.r i)))
259	    (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (Q.r i * Q.r j)))
260	    (W := fun i j k ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (Q.r i * (Q.r j * Q.r k))))
261	    (f' := (P.inter Q).r)
262	    (S' := fun p ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p)))
263	    (T' := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)))
264	    Prod.snd hτ hτT
265	    (W' := fun p q t ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p
266	      * ((P.inter Q).r q * (P.inter Q).r t))))
267	    (Q.isCoverCocycle γ) ((P.inter Q).isCoverCocycle γ) hrel
268	
269	/-- The two point-selections on the merge of two refinements of the same cover give the
270	same Picard class: they differ by the index-wise coboundary of the cross evaluations
271	`γ (P.pt i, Q.pt j)`. -/
272	theorem pic_interFst_eq_inter (P Q : 𝒰.BasicRefinement) (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
273	    (P.interFst Q).pic γ = (P.inter Q).pic γ := by
274	  letI := (P.inter Q).faithfullyFlat
275	  letI := (P.interFst Q).faithfullyFlat
276	  have hβle : ∀ p : P.ι × Q.ι, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p)
277	      ≤ 𝒰.opens (P.pt p.1) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (Q.pt p.2) :=
278	    fun p ↦ (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le
279	      (inf_le_inf (P.basicOpen_le p.1) (Q.basicOpen_le p.2))
280	  have hrel : ∀ p q : P.ι × Q.ι, ((P.interFst Q).coverCocycle γ p q).val
281	      = IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclLeft (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := (P.inter Q).r)
282	          (S := fun p ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p)))
283	          (T := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q))) p q
284	          ((X.unitsRestrict (hβle p) (unitsEvInf γ (P.pt p.1) (Q.pt p.2))).val)
285	        * (((P.inter Q).coverCocycle γ p q).val
286	          * IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclRight (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := (P.inter Q).r)
287	              (S := fun p ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p)))
288	              (T := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q))) p q
289	              (((X.unitsRestrict (hβle q) (unitsEvInf γ (P.pt q.1) (Q.pt q.2)))⁻¹).val)) := by
290	    intro p q
291	    rw [(P.inter Q).inclLeft_eq_basicRes p q, (P.inter Q).inclRight_eq_basicRes p q]
292	    have key : (P.interFst Q).coverCocycle γ p q
293	        = X.unitsRestrict ((P.inter Q).mul_le_left p q)
294	            (X.unitsRestrict (hβle p) (unitsEvInf γ (P.pt p.1) (Q.pt p.2)))
295	          * ((P.inter Q).coverCocycle γ p q
296	            * X.unitsRestrict ((P.inter Q).mul_le_right p q)
297	                ((X.unitsRestrict (hβle q) (unitsEvInf γ (P.pt q.1) (Q.pt q.2)))⁻¹)) := by
298	      rw [coverCocycle, coverCocycle, map_inv, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict,
299	        unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict]
300	      have e₁ := congrArg (X.unitsRestrict (le_inf
301	          (((P.inter Q).mul_le_left p q).trans (hβle p))
302	          (((P.inter Q).mul_le_right p q).trans ((hβle q).trans inf_le_right)) :
303	            X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)
304	              ≤ 𝒰.opens (P.pt p.1) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (Q.pt p.2) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (Q.pt q.2)))
305	        (unitsEvInf_trans γ (P.pt p.1) (Q.pt p.2) (Q.pt q.2))
306	      have e₂ := congrArg (X.unitsRestrict (le_inf (le_inf
307	          (((P.inter Q).mul_le_left p q).trans ((hβle p).trans inf_le_left))
308	          (((P.inter Q).mul_le_right p q).trans ((hβle q).trans inf_le_left)))
309	          (((P.inter Q).mul_le_right p q).trans ((hβle q).trans inf_le_right)) :
310	            X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)
311	              ≤ 𝒰.opens (P.pt p.1) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (P.pt q.1) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (Q.pt q.2)))
312	        (unitsEvInf_trans γ (P.pt p.1) (P.pt q.1) (Q.pt q.2))
313	      simp only [map_mul, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at e₁ e₂
314	      rw [← mul_assoc]
315	      exact eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq.mpr (e₂.trans e₁.symm)
316	    have hval := congrArg Units.val key
317	    simpa only [Units.val_mul, coe_unitsRestrict_basicOpen] using hval
318	  rw [pic_eq_picClass, pic_eq_picClass]
319	  exact IsLocalization.AwayCover.picClass_eq_of_coboundary (A := Γ(X, ⊤))
320	    (f := (P.inter Q).r)
321	    (S := fun p ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p)))
322	    (T := fun p q ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p * (P.inter Q).r q)))
323	    (W := fun p q t ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen ((P.inter Q).r p
324	      * ((P.inter Q).r q * (P.inter Q).r t))))
325	    ((P.inter Q).isCoverCocycle γ) ((P.interFst Q).isCoverCocycle γ)
326	    (fun p ↦ X.unitsRestrict (hβle p) (unitsEvInf γ (P.pt p.1) (Q.pt p.2))) hrel
327	
328	/-- **Any two basic refinements of the same pointed cover give the same Picard

\section{The \v Cech--Picard dictionary}

For a commutative ring \(A\), write \(\operatorname{Pic}(A)\) for its \emph{module} Picard
group: the group, under \(\otimes_A\), of isomorphism classes of invertible \(A\)-modules
--- those \(A\)-modules \(N\) admitting an \(A\)-module \(N'\) with \(N \otimes_A N' \cong A\).
This section identifies, for an affine scheme \(X\) with global ring \(A := \Gamma(X,\struct
X)\), the \v Cech Picard group \(\Pic(X)\) recalled at the head of the previous section ---
the colimit of the groups \(\check H^1(\mathcal U)\) of unit \v Cech \(1\)-cocycles on pointed
covers \(\mathcal U\) of \(X\) --- with \(\operatorname{Pic}(A)\).

For \(f \in A\), write \(D(f) \subseteq X\) for its basic open, the largest open on which the
image of \(f\) in every stalk is a unit; \(D(f) \cap D(g) = D(fg)\), and, \(X\) being affine, a
family \((D(f))_{f \in S}\) covers \(X\) exactly when \(S\) generates the unit ideal of \(A\).
A \emph{finite basic refinement} of a pointed cover \(\mathcal U\) is a finite pointed cover
\(\mathcal W\) refining \(\mathcal U\) all of whose members are basic opens \(D(r_i)\),
\(i \in I\), of elements \(r_i \in A\); since \(X\) is quasi-compact, being affine, every
pointed cover admits one. A unit \v Cech \(1\)-cocycle \(\delta\) on such a \(\mathcal W\)
determines a \emph{descent datum} for the finite faithfully flat algebra
\(A \to \prod_{i \in I} \Gamma(X, D(r_i))\), by twisting the tautological gluing data of the
free rank-one modules \(\Gamma(X,D(r_i))\) by the transition units \(\delta_{ij}\); faithfully
flat descent produces from this datum an \(A\)-module, well defined up to isomorphism, the
\emph{module descended from \(\delta\)}.

\begin{theorem}[Trivializing elements span the unit ideal]
  \label{thm:invertible_span_free}
  \lean{Module.Invertible.span_tensor_free_eq_top}
  \leanok
  Let \(A\) be a commutative ring and \(N\) an invertible \(A\)-module. The ideal generated by
  \[
    \{\, f \in A : S \otimes_A N \text{ is a free } S\text{-module for every localization } S
    \text{ of } A \text{ away from } f \,\}
  \]
  is the unit ideal of \(A\).
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
  \leanok
  An invertible module is finitely presented, and for every prime ideal \(\mathfrak p\) of
  \(A\) the localization of \(N\) at \(\mathfrak p\) is a finite flat module over the local
  ring \(A_{\mathfrak p}\), hence free; by finite presentation, freeness at \(\mathfrak p\)
  spreads out to freeness of \(S \otimes_A N\) for \(S\) a localization away from some single
  element \(f \notin \mathfrak p\). If the ideal generated by all such \(f\) were proper, it
  would be contained in some maximal ideal \(\mathfrak m\), contradicting the existence of a
  trivializing element outside \(\mathfrak m\). Hence the ideal is all of \(A\).
\end{proof}

  associated pointed cover. For points \(x,y \in X\), pushing \(\mathrm{triv}_x\) and

  the transition unit between two trivializations composes along a chain of further

  \mathcal U_F\) be any finite basic refinement of the trivializing cover. Then the class in

  obtained by restricting the trivializing cocycle to \(\mathcal W\) equals the class of \(N\).

  \leanok

  chosen point \(p(i)\) with \(\mathcal W(i) \subseteq \mathcal U_F(p(i))\). Restricting a
  transition unit is compatible with pushing forward its defining trivializations further, so

  trivializations assemble into one trivialization of \(N\) over the cover algebra

\begin{definition}[The \v Cech--Picard descent homomorphism]
  \label{def:cechPic_toPic}

  \leanok
  For an affine scheme \(X\) with global ring \(A = \Gamma(X,\struct X)\), the homomorphism of
  groups
  \[

    \mapsto \bigl(\text{class of the module descended from } \gamma|_{\mathcal W}\bigr),
  \]
  where \(\mathcal W\) is any finite basic refinement of \(\mathcal U\) and
  \(\gamma|_{\mathcal W}\) is the cocycle obtained by restricting \(\gamma\) along
  \(\mathcal W \le \mathcal U\).
\end{definition}
\begin{proof}
  \leanok

  \(\mathcal W\) of \(\mathcal U\): any two such refinements are dominated by a common one, along
  which the two descended modules become identified. Nor does it depend on the representative
  \((\mathcal U,\gamma)\) of the class \([\mathcal U,\gamma] \in \Pic(X)\): a further common
  refinement of two cohomologous representing cocycles carries cohomologous restricted
  cocycles, hence isomorphic descended modules. So \(\operatorname{toPic}\) is a well-defined
  function; it is a homomorphism because descending along a common refinement is compatible
  with the pointwise product of cocycles and with tensor product of the descended modules.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Injectivity of the descent homomorphism]
  \label{thm:cechPic_toPic_injective}

  \uses{def:cechPic_toPic, cor:cechPic_mk_eq_one}
  \leanok

  \Pic(X) \to \operatorname{Pic}(A)\) of Definition~\ref{def:cechPic_toPic} is injective.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
  \leanok

  Definition~\ref{def:cechPic_toPic}: since the module descended from \(\gamma|_{\mathcal W}\)
  is isomorphic to \(A\), its twisted descent datum is isomorphic to the trivial descent datum
  on \(\prod_i \Gamma(X,\mathcal W(i))\), so the transition units of \(\gamma\) restricted to
  \(\mathcal W\) differ from those of the trivial cocycle by an index-wise coboundary. Since the
  opens of \(\mathcal W\) refine those of \(\mathcal U\) and, member by member, cover them, this
  coboundary glues, by the sheaf property of \(\struct X\), to a coboundary for \(\gamma\)
  itself on \(\mathcal U\): \(\gamma = 1\) in \(\check H^1(\mathcal U)\). By
  Corollary~\ref{cor:cechPic_mk_eq_one}, \([\mathcal U,\gamma] = 1\) in \(\Pic(X)\).
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Surjectivity of the descent homomorphism]
  \label{thm:cechPic_toPic_surjective}

  \uses{def:cechPic_toPic, lem:trivializingFamily_nonempty, thm:trivializingFamily_pic_cocycle}
  \leanok
  For every affine scheme \(X\), the descent homomorphism \(\operatorname{toPic} \colon
  \Pic(X) \to \operatorname{Pic}(A)\) is surjective.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
  \leanok
  Let \(c \in \operatorname{Pic}(A)\) be represented by an invertible \(A\)-module \(N\). By
  Lemma~\ref{lem:trivializingFamily_nonempty}, \(N\) admits a trivializing family, giving a
  pointed cover \(\mathcal U_F\) together with the unit \v Cech \(1\)-cocycle \(\gamma_F\) of
  Definition~\ref{def:trivializingFamily_cocycle}. Since \(X\) is affine, hence quasi-compact,
  \(\mathcal U_F\) admits a finite basic refinement \(\mathcal W\). By
  Theorem~\ref{thm:trivializingFamily_pic_cocycle}, \(\operatorname{toPic}[\mathcal
  U_F,\gamma_F] = c\). As \(c\) was arbitrary, \(\operatorname{toPic}\) is surjective.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[The \v Cech--Picard dictionary]
  \label{thm:cechPicEquivPic}
  \lean{AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cechPicEquivPic}
  \uses{thm:cechPic_toPic_injective, thm:cechPic_toPic_surjective}
  \leanok
  For every affine scheme \(X\) with global ring \(A = \Gamma(X,\struct X)\), the descent
  homomorphism of Definition~\ref{def:cechPic_toPic} is an isomorphism of groups
  \[
    \operatorname{toPic} \colon \Pic(X) \;\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\; \operatorname{Pic}(A).
  \]

  \(X\) is canonically isomorphic to mathlib's Picard group of invertible \(A\)-modules.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
  \leanok
  \(\operatorname{toPic}\) is a bijective group homomorphism by
  Theorem~\ref{thm:cechPic_toPic_injective} (injectivity) and
  Theorem~\ref{thm:cechPic_toPic_surjective} (surjectivity), hence an isomorphism.
\end{proof}
